# PDF dependencies

Vendored builds used by the original design, loaded only when exporting:

- html2canvas 1.4.1 — https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js
- jsPDF 2.5.1 — https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js

Trailing whitespace in upstream license comments was normalized for git diff --check; executable code is unchanged.

Both use the MIT license; full notices are in the adjacent LICENSE files and
upstream copyright headers remain in each build. No CDN request is needed at runtime.
